headline: CLE @ DET matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CLE 4.60 at DET 3.47, with a projected total of 8.07. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CLE: CLE moved -0.15 runs while DET moved -0.49, changing the projected margin by +0.34 runs. The projected total fell -0.64, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +11.4%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Parker Messick has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Riley Greene, Travis Bazzana, José Ramírez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Petey Halpin, Rhys Hoskins because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
